description: This PHP file generates a web-based user interface for generating, viewing, printing, and downloading parental control reports. It includes HTML markup, JavaScript for dynamic interactions, and PHP snippets to retrieve specific configuration data. The core functionality involves a JavaScript function that fetches report data via AJAX, as well as user interface controls to select report types and time frames.
published: parsing and defining report UI components, as well as AJAX interactions for report data

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs AJAX request to fetch report data based on selected mode and time frame, updates the corresponding report table, and manages UI elements like print/download buttons.
